description: Look up a single app by its store ID. Returns app metadata including name, developer, category, rating, reviews, installs (Android), and price. Works without an API key (free tier, limited daily use per IP).

store.description: App store. "ios" for Apple App Store, "android" for Google Play.

store_id.description: Store-specific app identifier. iOS: numeric track ID (e.g. "123456789"). Android: package name (e.g. "com.spotify.music").

name: sonar_app_lookup
title: Look Up App
